y-m-64-06.title: Ithuba litshintsha njani njengoko ulwazi longezwa isiqwenga ngexesha?
y-m-64-06.topic: Ithuba elinemeko: indlela ithuba elitshintsha ngayo njengoko ulwazi longezwa
y-m-64-06.goal: Landela, ngokubala iimeko, indlela ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi olutsha lufika iimeko ezinokwenzeka ziyancipha kwaye ithuba liyanyuka, lihlala linjalo, okanye liba li-1.
y-m-64-06.material: Idayisi ebomvu neluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ziphoswa kanye nganye. Idayisi ezimbini zilungile kwaye azichaphazelani, kwaye ubuso ngabunye obusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-6 buvela ngethuba elilinganayo. Ukuba isixa sobuso obubini si-8 okanye ngaphezulu, kubizwa 'impumelelo'. Isiphumo asikaziwa, kwaye ulwazi lunikwa isiqwenga ngexesha.
y-m-64-06.thinking.0: Jonga indlela ulwazi olutsha lutshintsha ngayo iimeko ezinokwenzeka
y-m-64-06.thinking.1: Chaza iziseko zokulungisa okanye zokugcina isigwebo
y-m-64-06.prereq.0: 'H1' kulo msebenzi sisalathiso sobunzima nenqanaba lenkxaso kuphela kule msebenzi yemveliso kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam isabela lo mxholo kunyaka othile wesikolo. Icinga ukuba uhlangabezane, kwi-Probability and Statistics yesikolo samabanga aphezulu, nendlela yokufumana ithuba njenge-(inani leemeko ezenzekayo) ÷ (inani leemeko zonke).
y-m-64-06.prereq.1: Amava okudwelisa ubuso beedayisi ezimbini njengezibini ezilandelelanayo ezingama-36 (ubuso bedayisi ebomvu, ubuso bedayisi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka)
y-m-64-06.prereq.2: Ingcinga ethi 'gcina kuphela iimeko ezihambelana nolwazi olunikiweyo'
y-m-64-06.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi lutyhilwa isiqwenga ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha ukuba ithuba 'lempumelelo' likhulu kangakanani.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha ufumana ulwazi, bhala iimeko ezingama-36 kwitheyibhile, wuncede iiseli ezingahambelani nolwazi, ubale iiseli eziseleyo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bala inani leeseli eziseleyo ezinesixa 8 okanye ngaphezulu, bhala umlinganiselo, uthelekise ecaleni komlinganiselo wenyathelo langaphambili.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Oku kungaphambi kokuphosa. Akukho lwazi ngobuso okwangoku.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ithuba lempumelelo (isixa sobuso obubini si-8 okanye ngaphezulu) lingakanani?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Iimeko ezinesixa 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 ziindlela ezi-5, 4, 3, 2, 1 ngokulandelelana, ngoko iindlela ezili-15 zonke. Ithuba li-15/36 = 5/12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ukuba ubhala zonke iimeko ezinesixa 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, aziyi-12 iindlela. Hlola ukuba zingaphi iindlela ezilahlekileyo kuwuphi isixa.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Oku kuqikelelo olwathatha ixabiso eliphakathi lezixa, 7, njengomgca wokwahlula lwabona kuyisiqingatha. Iindlela ezi-6 ezinesixa 7 azizizo impumelelo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Oku kuhambelana nexabiso lokubala iimeko ezinesixa 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 nokuzidibanisa.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Oku kusenokuba luqikelelo oluvakalise '8 okanye ngaphezulu' luluhlu olubanzi phakathi kwezixa ezi-6 (7 ukuya kwi-12). Isixa sikhula ngakumbi, iimeko ziyancipha.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Umfundi uxelela kuphela ukuba 'isixa sobuso obubini siqhelekile'. Awukazi ubuso okwangoku.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Iimeko ezinesixa esiqhelekileyo ziindlela ezili-18 (izixa 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 zineendlela ezi-1, 3, 5, 5, 3, 1 ngokulandelelana), kwaye phakathi kwazo impumelelo (izixa 8, 10, 12) iindlela ezi-9. Ithuba li-9/18 = 1/2, elaba likhulu kune-5/12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Oku kuhambelana nexabiso lokubala, phakathi kweendlela ezili-18 ezinesixa esiqhelekileyo, iindlela ezi-5 + 3 + 1 = 9 ezinesixa 8, 10, 12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulwazi lokuba isixa siqhelekile lunciphisa iimeko ezinokwenzeka ukusuka kwiindlela ezingama-36 ukuya kwezili-18. Kufuneka ubale kwakhona ngaphakathi kweemeko ezincitshisiweyo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ukuba ugcina kuphela iimeko ezinesixa esiqhelekileyo, isabelo seemeko ezinesixa 8, 10, 12 sikhula ngakumbi ngokwenene. Bala wena iimeko eziseleyo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Likhule kakhulu, laba malunga ne-5/6 okanye ngaphezulu
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Iimeko ezinesixa esiqhelekileyo ziquka nezixa 2, 4, 6. Iimeko ezininzi ezingezizo impumelelo ziseleyo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Umfundi uyongeza: 'Isixa siqhelekile, kwaye ubuso beedayisi ezimbini bahlukile omnye komnye.'
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Iimeko ezinesixa esiqhelekileyo nobuso obahlukileyo ziindlela ezili-18 - 6 = 12, kwaye phakathi kwazo iimpumelelo zindlela ezi-9 - 3 = 6. Ithuba li-6/12 = 1/2, lihleli linjalo. Iimeko ezi-3 zempumelelo (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) zasuswa kunye, ngoko umlinganiselo awutshintshanga.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukuba ususa iimeko apho ubuso bufanayo, iimeko zempumelelo ziyasuswa nazo. Bala ukuba kususwa kangakanani kwicala ngalinye.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Hlola ukuba ucinge ukuba iimeko ezinobuso obufanayo zisecaleni elingeyiyo impumelelo kuphela. Zeziphi izixa ze-(4,4), (5,5), (6,6)?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ulwazi olutsha lwongeziwe, ngoko kufuneka litshintshe
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ulwazi olutsha alutshintshi ithuba ngalo lonke ixesha. Bala iimeko eziseleyo uhlole umlinganiselo wena.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Olu luvo lubale ukuhlola ukuba nokuba iimeko ezinobuso obufanayo zisuswa, iimeko zempumelelo ziyasuswa nazo ngomlinganiselo ofanayo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.info: Olu lolona lwazi lokugqibela. Uxelelwa ukuba ubuso bedayisi ebomvu bu-6. (Isixa siqhelekile, kwaye ubuso obubini bahlukile.)
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.after: Ukuba ubuso obubomvu bu-6 kwaye isixa siqhelekile, ubuso obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka bunye kwezi-2, 4, 6, kwaye kuba ubuso obubini bahlukile, u-6 ukhutshiwe, kushiyeka u-2 okanye u-4. Isixa si-8 okanye si-10, zombini zi-8 okanye ngaphezulu, ngoko ithuba li-1.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Nje ukuba ubuso bedayisi ebomvu bulungisiwe, ubuso obunokwenzeka bedayisi eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka buncipha kakhulu. Bhala wena iimeko eziseleyo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Olu luvo luqinisekise ukuba iimeko eziseleyo ngobuso obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka 2 no-4 kuphela, izixa zazo zi-8 no-10, zombini zimpumelelo.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ungahlola ngokubhala wena ukuba ikhona na iimeko ezingezizo impumelelo phakathi kweezisele.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Bala omnye ngomnye izixa zeemeko apho ubuso obubomvu bu-6, isixa siqhelekile, kwaye ubuso obuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka abuyi-6.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.reflect: Ithuba litshintshe njenge-5/12 → 1/2 → 1/2 → 1. Ngawaphi amaqhekeza olwazi atshintshe ithuba, kwaye angawaphi angatshintshanga? Chaza kwenzeka ntoni xa ulwazi lunciphisa iimeko ezinokwenzeka kwaye iimeko zempumelelo neezingezizo impumelelo ziyancipha ngomlinganiselo ofanayo.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.prompt: Kwinyathelo 3, ulwazi 'ubuso obubini bahlukile' longezwa kodwa ithuba alitshintshanga. Chaza ukuba kutheni lingatshintshanga, usebenzisa amanani eemeko eziseleyo.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala iimeko ezi-6 ezisuswe kwinyathelo 3 kwitheyibhile ubale ukuba zingaphi kuzo ezinesixa se-8 okanye ngaphezulu.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala 'inani leemeko zempumelelo ÷ inani leemeko zonke' phambi nasemva kokususwa uzithelekise.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: Nokuba sisusa iimeko ezinobuso obufanayo, ...
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uthe inani leemeko zempumelelo (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) phakathi kweemeko ezisuswe (iimeko ezi-6 ezinobuso obufanayo)?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale ngamazwi akho inqaku lokuba 'ulwazi olutsha alutshintshi ithuba ngalo lonke ixesha'?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.0: Phakathi kweemeko ezi-6 ezinobuso obufanayo, ezo ezinesixa se-8 okanye ngaphezulu ziimeko ezi-3 (4,4), (5,5), (6,6), isiqingatha ncam. Phakathi kweendlela ezili-18 ezinesixa esiqhelekileyo, impumelelo yaba ziindlela ezi-9, isiqingatha, ngoko nokuba emva kokususa iimeko ezi-6 ezinobuso obufanayo, impumelelo ngama-6 kwiindlela ezili-12 eziseleyo, kwaye umlinganiselo uhlala u-1/2.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.1: Nokuba sisusa iimeko ezinobuso obufanayo, isabelo esinesixa se-8 okanye ngaphezulu phakathi kweemeko eziseleyo sisaphindaphindwe sisiqingatha (6/12), ngoko ithuba alitshintshanga. Ulwazi olutsha lunciphise iimeko ezinokwenzeka, kodwa lunciphise iimeko zempumelelo neezingezizo impumelelo ngomlinganiselo ofanayo.

y-m-64-09.title: Ngaba singawathatha amanani empumelelo kule meko njengokuphindaphinda okunethuba elifanayo?
y-m-64-09.topic: Ukwahlulwa kwebinomiyali: iimeko apho imodeli ihambelana nezo ingahambelaniyo khona
y-m-64-09.goal: Gweba, imeko ngemeko, ukuba ziziphi iimeko ezifunekayo ukuze inani leempumelelo kuhlolo oluphindaphindiweyo lithathwe njengelebinomiyali, uze uqinisekise ngamanani ukuba isiphumo sokubala siguquka njani xa ezo meko zophulwa.
y-m-64-09.material: Ukuze sithathe inani leempumelelo njengelilandela ukwahlulwa kwebinomiyali, (1) inani lemizamo kufuneka libe lisisigxina, (2) umzamo ngamnye kufuneka ube nesiphumo esinye kwezibini, impumelelo okanye ukusilela, (3) ithuba lempumelelo kufuneka lifane kuyo yonke imizamo, kwaye (4) imizamo akufuneki ichaphazelane. Sifuna ukujonga ezi meko zine kwiimeko ezingezantsi. Ibhokisi iqulathe iibhola ezimhlophe ezi-6 neebhola ezimnyama ezi-4.
y-m-64-09.thinking.2: Dibanisa umahluko wamaxabiso nesizathu xa imodeli ingalunganga
y-m-64-09.prereq.0: I-'H1' kulo msebenzi sisalathisi kuphela sobunzima kunye nenqanaba lenkxaso kule ngxelo yemveliso, kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam inikela esi sihloko kunyaka othile wesikolo. Kuthathelwa ekuhleni ukuba ubuhlangane, kwi-Probability and Statistics yesikolo samabanga aphezulu, nokuzama okuzimeleyo nentsingiselo yokwahlulwa kwebinomiyali (inani leempumelelo elibalwa ngokuphinda impumelelo enethuba elifanayo amaxesha angu-n).
y-m-64-09.prereq.1: Amava okubala iindlela zokukhetha ezinye kwizinto ezahlukeneyo
y-m-64-09.prereq.2: Amava okuchaza ngamagama umahluko phakathi kokukhetha kunye nokungabuyiseli nokubuyisela
y-m-64-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iimeko ezingezantsi apho 'inani leempumelelo' linokuthathwa njengelebinomiyali.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kukhetho ngalunye, jonga iimeko ezine enye emva kwenye ungatsibi nanye. Ngokukodwa, jonga ukuba ithuba lempumelelo lifana kuyo yonke imizamo na.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kukhetho apho ithuba livakala litshintsha, zibhalele wena indlela ithuba elitshintsha ngayo emva komzamo wokuqala ukuze uqinisekise.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.a: Inani leebhola ezimhlophe eziphuma xa uthatha iibhola ngaphandle kwebhokisi enye ngexesha, ujonge umbala, ungazibuyiseli, uthathe amaxesha angu-5
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.a: Ngalo lonke ixesha uthatha nje enye, umlinganiselo weebhola ezimhlophe ebhokisini uyatshintsha, ngoko ithuba lempumelelo kumzamo ngamnye aliqhubeki lifana.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.b: Inani leempumelelo xa umdlali onoqikelelo lwempumelelo lwe-0.6 ephosa amaxesha ali-10 amaphoso asimahla phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo, kuthathelwa ekuhleni ukuba iziphumo zangaphambili aziphembeleli ezo zilandelayo
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukhetho olujonge ukuba zonke iimeko ezine zikwisivakalisi.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.c: Inani leempumelelo xa lo mdlali uphosa amaxesha ali-10, ulandela umthetho wokuba izinga elilandelayo lempumelelo li-0.8 ukuba umzamo wangaphambili ube yimpumelelo kunye ne-0.4 ukuba ube kukusilela
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.c: Ithuba lempumelelo yomzamo litshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwisiphumo sangaphambili, ngoko imizamo iyachaphazelana.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.d: Inani leebhola ezimhlophe eziphuma xa uphinda amaxesha angu-5 ukuthatha ibhola enye ebhokisini, ujonge umbala, uze uyibuyisele
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.d: Oku kukhetho olujonge ukuba, kuba ibhola iyabuyiselwa, imeko yebhokisi iyafana ngalo lonke ixesha.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.e: Inani lemibuzo eyiphendule ngokuchanekileyo xa uqikelela ngokungacwangciswanga yonke imibuzo eli-10 enolwabiwo lweendlela ezine (imibuzo ayichaphazelani)
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.e: Oku kukhetho olujonge ukuba ithuba lokuphendula ngokuchanekileyo umbuzo ngamnye liyafana kwaye ayichaphazelani.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.explain: Kwi-b, i-d ne-e, inani lemizamo lisisigxina, ithuba lempumelelo kumzamo ngamnye aliguquki, yaye imizamo ayichaphazelani. Kwi-a, iibhola ezithatyiweyo azibuyiselwa, ngoko ithuba litshintsha ngomzamo ngamnye, yaye kwi-c, isiphumo sangaphambili sitshintsha ithuba elilandelayo, ngoko imizamo iyachaphazelana.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.prompt: Lingakanani ithuba lokuba umdlali okukhetho b (izinga lempumelelo le-0.6) aphumelele kanye amaxesha ali-7 kwali-10?
y-m-64-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ityala elinye elinempumelelo ezisi-7 nokusilela okuku-3, uze ufumane ithuba leli tyala.

y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.b: Uphindaphinde ithuba lempumelelo ezisi-7 kuphela kwaye awuzange ubonakalise imeko yokuba ezi-3 eziseleyo zizilele.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.c: Uthathe umlinganiselo weempumelelo (7/10) njengethuba. Wahlukile kwithuba lokuba mangaphi kwali-10 ayimpumelelo.

y-m-64-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uyichazile na, kubandakanywa nalapho ikhomba khona, isizathu sokuba ifomula yebinomiyali ibe likhulu kunexabiso lokwenyani?

y-m-64-10.title: Ingaba amanqaku aphezulu ngokwenene sisiphumo esingcono?
y-m-64-10.topic: Ukwabiwa okuqhelekileyo nokwenza imigangatho: ukuthelekisa amanqaku

y-m-64-10.thinking.2: Hlaziya isigwebo sakho xa idatha entsha ityhudisa ingcamango

Kuthathelwa ekuhleni ukuba ubuhlangane, kwi-Probability and Statistics yesikolo samabanga aphezulu, nokwabiwa okuqhelekileyo nomndilili kunye nokuphambuka okuqhelekileyo.
